Flutter SDK archive

docs.flutter.dev/install/archive
After you download a release, to set up Flutter, follow the manual installation instructions. The archive includes Flutter SDKs for Windows, macOS, and Linux on the following channels: Stable channel: This channel contains the most stable Flutter builds. Roughly every third beta version is promoted to the stable version.
